invariants.rationale: A null check is performed in the method body via region = layer.getTextureRegion(); if region == null return, but 'layer' itself should not be null to call methods on it safely.
batch.draw is called with region.getTexture(); method returns early if region is null, so if not null, getTexture() must also be usable and non-null.
Layer X coordinate used as a position; it may reasonably be non-negative in most map scenarios.
Layer Y coordinate used as a position; often non-negative in world-space layouts.

invariants.expression: layer.isRepeatX() == true || layer.isRepeatY() == true || (layer.isRepeatX() == false && layer.isRepeatY() == false)
invariants.rationale: The code distinguishes between the cases when both repeats are false and when either is true; these are the only possibilities.
